plan.rationale: This operation explicitly parses category mappings to left, middle, and right baskets and performs visually grounded grasp-and-place. RGB shows cars, watches, wooden toys, and three open baskets compatible with the requested placement geometry. Its observation-batch input and end-effector action-chunk output fit the supplied interface. Unlike visual-attribute-placement, it preserves the specified category-to-basket assignments rather than choosing destinations by transfer cost. Arm reset is a shared lifecycle action after placement.
